From Ratt · Price: your stand must stay still to fire (it can't move in a turn it fires a dart).

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: dart, range 30 ft: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[acid]] (attack roll), and 1d6 persistent acid on a hit. An automatic stand instead fires at anything moving, and doesn't need to stay still.
  • 5: Darts melt a creature's flesh: on a critical hit, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} for 1 minute. Surge (1 action): three darts at different targets, each @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[acid]].
  • 9: The persistent acid is 2d6.
  • 13: On any hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} until the end of your next turn (1 minute on a critical hit).
  • 17: The persistent acid is 3d6, and darts ignore resistance to acid.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
